subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on BMW engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the S62 across all 1 model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The S62 is a single-application engine — the E39 M5, 1999–2003. It's one of the most iconic engines BMW M ever built, and we work on it regularly.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the S62. While some owners discuss rod bearing wear in high-mileage examples, we don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode. Diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page - they'll be added once a documented set of completed S62 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
